lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field assessments to estimate acutely food insecure populations across Zimbabwe under different scenarios. Population estimates were aggregated and compiled into a time-series dataset for 2019 to track food insecurity impacts driven by drought and other underlying hazards.
